faq.a: There is no additional per player charge, meaning that your total price will not go up whether you come alone or bring five of your friends!

faq.q: How many players can share a bay?
faq.a: There is no additional charge for having more players in your bay (a maximum of six).

faq.q: How long does a round take?
faq.a: A nine-hole course will take you roughly half an hour as a solo player. If you're playing with three friends, that nine-hole course will likely take two hours. 18 holes takes about 1 hour per player.

faq.q: How many guests can attend a private event?
faq.a: 7,500 square feet for events up to 150 guests.

faq.q: What else is there besides golf?
faq.a: Indoor miniature golf, shuffleboard at our 22-foot table, foosball, a shooting simulator, VR gaming, and Mulligan's, our in-house bar and grill.
Duane Carleton performs at Stonehedge every Friday night (6PM-9PM).
We have the NFL Sunday Ticket and are NOW OPEN on Sundays (12PM-7PM). We'll have EVERY NFL GAME being broadcast!

faq.q: Can we start our own league?
faq.a: Have a group of 8-to-24 that's interested in forming a new, indoor, golf league? Give us a call and we'll do our best to create a customized golf league for you and your group!
